head: 10 new productivity apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These productivity apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Productivity charts this week, from a handwriting notebook and a talking keyboard to planners, countdowns and a shift calendar.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Productivity charts (paid, plus Hex in free) this week
means: If you're looking for a new planner, notebook or a way to type by voice, these are the new productivity apps people in the US are buying right now, most of them for a one-time price.
todo: Read each App Store page before you buy: TypeDraw sells extra notebooks for $1.99 each, and Upp needs an NFC tag you stick somewhere in your home.

list.name: TypeDraw
list.what: A handwriting notebook app; one notebook with unlimited pages comes with the purchase, and up to four more cost $1.99 each.

list.name: Freedom Forge Today
list.what: A planner that starts with one box and sorts tasks, links and recipes into Today, Soon and Someday instead of due dates.

list.name: My Anti-Rot Year
list.what: A year-long journal for people who want to scroll less, with monthly missions, rituals and a letter to your future self that stays sealed for a year.

list.name: Orbit: Quick Launch Wheel
list.what: Puts the apps you open most on a 3D wheel you spin and tap, with separate wheels for work, home or travel and Home Screen widgets.

list.name: Hex: voice dictation keyboard
list.what: A keyboard you can talk to in any app; speech is turned into text on the iPhone, with no account, and works offline once a language is downloaded.

list.name: RadPad - 90s Notebook
list.what: A notes app styled like a 90s school binder, with a randomly printed cover you can re-roll three times and loose-leaf pages you type on.

list.name: Any Day Now: Event Countdowns
list.what: Counts down to trips, exams, birthdays and other dates, with your own colors or cover photo, calendars and Home Screen widgets.

list.name: My Bookmarks by SC360
list.what: Saves links from the Share button in Safari, Chrome or any app into groups, tags and favorites, with a Vault that hides private links.

list.name: Upp: NFC Alarm Clock
list.what: An alarm that only stops ringing when you scan an NFC tag you've stuck somewhere else in your home, like on the coffee machine.

list.name: FernShift: Shift Calendar
list.what: A work calendar for rotating shifts, with repeating 8-week patterns for 12-hour or 8-hour shifts and a calendar you can share with family.
